newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH LOT TO BUY FOUR BOEING PLANES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH LOT TO BUY FOUR BOEING PLANES.

text.p: Polish national airline PLL LOT SA are likely to sign on Wednesday a deal worth about $160 million with Boeing Commercial Airplane Group on the purchase of four new Boeing 737 airplanes, LOT spokesman said on Tuesday.
Marek Slawatyniec told Reuters the first two planes were likely to arrive in Poland in May 1997 and the remaining by late 1998..
"LOT is likely to sign a deal with Boeing on the purchase of four 737 planes for roughly $160 million on Wednesday," Slawatyniec said.
"However, negotiations usually last until the very end so the final details will be known on Wednesday," he said.
LOT currently has 11 Boeing 737 planes, four Boeing 767s, and seven ATR 72 turboprop short-distance aircraft. It intends to boost its fleet by eight boeing 737's in the next few years.
